name: nangua-gallery
description: Private Apple Photos-style gallery for an existing Cloudflare R2 image host

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,worker -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @nangua/web" "npm run dev -w @nangua/worker"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nangua/web && npm run build -w @nangua/worker
scripts.deploy: npm run build -w @nangua/web && npm run deploy -w @nangua/worker
